steps: The initial number of nuclei is N_0 = 48 × 10^23 and the final number is N_t = 6 × 10^23.
The ratio N_0 / N_t = 48 / 6 = 8, which is exactly 2^3, meaning 3 half-lives have passed.
Since 3 half-lives correspond to 3 minutes, the half-life T_1/2 is exactly 1 minute.
The decay constant is λ = ln(2) / T_1/2 = 0.693 / 1 = 0.693 min^-1.
The mean life is τ = 1 / λ = 1 / 0.693 min.
Calculating this gives τ ≈ 1.44 minutes, which matches option (B).
